detail.readme:
Rust native web build tool with an official Rust plugin ecosystem

English | 简体中文


--- ## Intro Farm is a Rust native web build tool. Its compiler and built-in compilation plugins handle the module graph, transformation, bundling and optimization in Rust. Official Rust plugins extend this pipeline for frameworks, styling, assets and documentation. Node.js provides configuration, CLI and development-server orchestration. JavaScript plugins, React rendering and application runtimes remain part of the stack where needed. Vite-compatible plugin adapters provide a migration path; they are not the definition of Farm’s architecture. This branch contains the v2 release candidate. Source versions and plugin implementations do not establish registry availability or completed release acceptance. Use a matching verified candidate for v2 evaluation; `@latest` commands select the version currently published to the registry. ## Online experience [![Edit Farm](https://codesandbox.io/static/img/play-codesandbox.svg)](https://codesandbox.io/p/github/ErKeLost/react/main) ## Why Farm? Farm puts the compiler and compilation extensions on a native Rust foundation, with one plugin architecture for development and production. It combines incremental compilation and configurable bundling with adapters for existing JavaScript tooling. See [Why Farm](https://farmfe.org/docs/why-farm) for architecture and migration details. ## Features - **Rust native compilation**: a Rust compiler and built-in plugins for scripts, CSS, HTML, JSON, resolution and production optimization. - **Official Rust plugin families**: React/Vue, Sass/Tailwind CSS, import automation, SVG/icons, data and assets, workers/Wasm, and documentation tooling. See the [plugin overview](website/docs/plugins/official-plugins/overview.md) for source scope and candidate status. Feature coverage varies by plugin. - **Incremental workflows**: persistent caching, lazy compilation and hot updates; results depend on workload, configuration and cache state. - **Partial bundling**: control output grouping while keeping development and production on the same compiler foundation. - **Extensible migration**: Rust and JavaScript compilation plugins, runtime plugins and Vite-compatible adapters. Verify the hooks and framework features your project uses instead of assuming every Vite plugin is interchangeable. V2 package publication, platform payloads and release acceptance are tracked separately from the availability of source code. ## Getting Started Create a new Farm project with your favorite package manager: ```bash # with npm npm create farm@latest # with yarn yarn create farm@latest # with pnpm pnpm create farm@latest ``` Visit [Farm Documentation](https://farmfe.org) to learn more about Farm. ## Benchmark Historical benchmark data and its workload are available in [performance-compare](https://github.com/farm-fe/performance-compare). These results are not measurements of this v2 candidate or guarantees for your project. Compare the same content, configuration, hardware and cache state when evaluating v2. ## Contribution See [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/farm-fe/farm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Chat With Us - [Author Twitter](https://twitter.com/brightwwu46799), [Official Twitter](https://twitter.com/FarmFe71928) - With [Discord](https://discord.gg/mDErq9aFnF) - Wechat group
- QQ group
## Contributors



## Credits Thanks to https://github.com/tmm who donated the [farm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/farm) npm package to the Farm team. Thanks to projects: - The [SWC](https://github.com/swc-project/swc) project created by [@kdy1](https://github.com/kdy1), which powers Farm's code parsing, transformation and minification. - The [NAPI-RS](https://github.com/napi-rs/napi-rs) project created by [@Brooooooklyn](https://github.com/Brooooooklyn), which powers Farm's node-binding implementation. - The [Rollup](https://github.com/rollup/rollup) project created by [@lukastaegert](https://github.com/lukastaegert), which inspired Farm's plugin system implementation. - The [Vite](https://github.com/vitejs/vite) project created by [Evan You](https://github.com/yyx990803), which inspired Farm's compatibility design of ecosystem. ## Author & Maintainer Author: - [brightwu（吴明亮）](https://github.com/wre232114)，worked at bytedance. [Twitter](https://twitter.com/brightwwu46799) Maintainer: - [ErKeLost](https://github.com/ErKeLost) - [shulandmimi](https://github.com/shulandmimi)
detail.readme_zh:
Rust native Web 构建工具与官方 Rust 插件生态

English | 简体中文


--- ## 介绍 Farm 是 Rust native Web 构建工具。编译器及内置编译插件在 Rust 中处理模块图、转换、打包与优化，官方 Rust 插件进一步覆盖框架、样式、资源与文档构建。 Node.js 负责配置、CLI 与开发服务器编排；需要时仍会使用 JavaScript 插件、React 渲染与应用运行时。Vite 插件适配器用于渐进迁移，而不是 Farm 架构的定义。 本分支包含 v2 发布候选。源码中的版本与插件实现不代表对应包已在 registry 发布或已完成正式版验收。评估 v2 时应使用匹配且经过验证的候选；`@latest` 命令安装的是 registry 当前已发布版本。 ## 在线体验 [![Edit Farm](https://codesandbox.io/static/img/play-codesandbox.svg)](https://codesandbox.io/p/github/ErKeLost/react/main) ## 为什么选择 Farm？ Farm 以 Rust 原生编译器和编译扩展为基础，为开发与生产提供统一的插件架构，并结合增量编译、可配置打包和现有 JavaScript 工具的适配能力。架构与迁移说明见[为什么需要 Farm](https://farmfe.org/zh/docs/why-farm)。 ## 特性 - **Rust native 编译**：Rust 编译器与内置插件覆盖脚本、CSS、HTML、JSON、解析及生产优化。 - **官方 Rust 插件家族**：覆盖 React/Vue、Sass/Tailwind CSS、自动导入、SVG/图标、数据与资源、Worker/Wasm 及文档工具。功能范围和候选状态见[插件总览](website/i18n/zh/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/plugins/official-plugins/overview.md)，不同插件的覆盖程度并不相同。 - **增量工作流**：持久缓存、懒编译与热更新；效果取决于项目、配置和缓存状态。 - **局部打包**：控制产物分组，开发与生产使用同一编译器基础。 - **可扩展与渐进迁移**：支持 Rust/JavaScript 编译插件、运行时插件和 Vite 适配器。请验证项目实际使用的 hooks 与框架功能，不假设所有 Vite 插件都可直接替换。 v2 包发布、各平台原生产物及正式版验收，与源码是否存在分别跟踪。 ## 快速开始 使用任意常用包管理器，即可快速创建一个 Farm 项目: ```bash # npm npm create farm@latest # yarn yarn create farm@latest # pnpm pnpm create farm@latest ``` 查看 [Farm 文档](https://farmfe.org) 了解更多用法。 ## 基准测试 历史基准数据与对应工作负载保留在 [performance-compare](https://github.com/farm-fe/performance-compare)。这些结果不是本次 v2 候选的实测，也不是对项目耗时的保证。评估 v2 时应固定内容、配置、硬件和缓存状态后再比较。 ## 贡献 查看 [贡献指南](https://github.com/farm-fe/farm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md) ## 交流群 - [作者推特](https://twitter.com/brightwwu46799), [官方推特](https://twitter.com/fe_farm) - 加入 [Discord](https://discord.gg/mDErq9aFnF) - 微信交流群
- QQ 群
## 感谢贡献者们做出的努力



## 致谢 非常感谢 https://github.com/tmm 给 Farm 团队捐献了 [farm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/farm) npm 包。 感谢: - [SWC](https://github.com/swc-project/swc) 项目由[@kdy1](https://github.com/kdy1)创建, 为 Farm 的代码解析、转换和压缩提供了支持。 - [NAPI-RS](https://github.com/napi-rs/napi-rs) 项目由 [@Brooooooklyn](https://github.com/Brooooooklyn)创建, 为 Farm 的 node-binding 实现提供了支持。 - [Rollup](https://github.com/rollup/rollup) 项目由 [@lukastaegert](https://github.com/lukastaegert)创建, 启发了 Farm 的插件系统的实现。 - [Vite](https://github.com/vitejs/vite) 项目由 [Evan You](https://github.com/yyx990803)创建, 针对 Vite 插件生态的兼容性设计提供了启发。 ## 作者 & 维护者 作者： - [brightwu（吴明亮）](https://github.com/wre232114)，, 曾就职于字节跳动。[推特](https://twitter.com/brightwwu46799) 维护者： - [ErKeLost](https://github.com/ErKeLost) - [shulandmimi](https://github.com/shulandmimi)
